topic: Platform access and user permissions review
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered technical issues with platform login credentials, specifically noting that the email recorded in the database may not match the actual domain. It was discussed that the staging environment frequently experiences downtime due to deployments.

Regarding user permissions, it was confirmed that client planners are restricted from selecting facilities using a specific account ([email@oaam.com.my]). This restriction is intentional and aligns with previous requests. The general principle established is that campaign planner roles should have limited visibility to prevent them from seeing unnecessary data.
decisions: Client planners are restricted from choosing facilities via the specified login.
Campaign planner roles must maintain limited access to sensitive data.
